headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, with Junior Caminero leading the Royals' offense with 3 hits and 3 home runs. Ian Seymour pitched 6.2 scoreless innings for the Rays. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Bubba Chandler earning the win. The Oakland Athletics took down the San Francisco Giants 9-6, with Victor Bericoto leading the offense and Landen Roupp pitching 6 strong innings.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Tony Santillan, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Cincinnati Reds due to a left oblique strain. The Arizona Diamondbacks transferred Ryne Nelson from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a strained right elbow. The Philadelphia Phillies placed Johan Rojas on the 60-day injured list for right elbow UCL repair.

The Chicago Cubs made a notable trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis. The St. Louis Cardinals traded right-hander Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Washington Nationals traded shortstop Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash, and the Atlanta Braves acquired right-hander Tyler Schoff from the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Rays in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, handing them a one-sided loss. Junior Caminero led the Royals' offense with 3 hits and 3 home runs, while Ian Seymour pitched 6.2 scoreless innings for the Rays.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Bubba Chandler earning the win. Brandon Lowe led the Mariners' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Giants 9-6**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 9-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants, with Victor Bericoto leading the offense with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Landen Roupp pitched 6 strong innings, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros edged out the Detroit Tigers 2-1 in a closely contested game. Tatsuya Imai led the Astros' pitching staff with 6.0 innings pitched, 10 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds RHP Tony Santillan Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds right-hander Tony Santillan has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain, effective retroactive to June 23, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Hander David Peterson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade with the New York Mets. Peterson joins the Cubs after being dealt for third baseman Cole Mathis.
